articles.title: Iran war: What is happening on day 35 of US-Israeli attacks?
articles.summary: The United States and Israel are expanding attacks on Iran, targeting infrastructure near its capital. This reflects Washington's increased pressure on Tehran amidst a spreading regional conflict. For SSB aspirants, this signifies growing geopolitical instability in the Middle East, impacting global security and requiring awareness of international flashpoints and power dynamics in current affairs.

articles.title: What is Mission Mitra? Shubhanshu Shukla, along with other Gaganyaan astronauts, arrive in Leh for India’s toughest space training yet
articles.summary: India's Gaganyaan astronauts, including Shubhanshu Shukla, have commenced their toughest space training yet in Leh. This rigorous program is a vital part of 'Mission Mitra', preparing them for India's ambitious manned space flight. The intensive high-altitude training aims to simulate extreme conditions, ensuring the astronauts are fully prepared for the challenges of future space missions.

articles.title: India’s defence exports hit all-time high: Here’s what Indian arms companies are shipping to US, France and more
articles.summary: India's defence exports have soared to an unprecedented Rs 38,424 crore in FY 2025-26, marking a significant 62.7% increase from the previous year. This record achievement underscores India's growing self-reliance in defence manufacturing and its increasing presence in the global defence market, reflecting enhanced capabilities and strategic importance for national security.

articles.title: U2 Surprise Release Six-Song Spiritual EP Easter Lily
articles.summary: Iconic rock band U2 has unexpectedly released a new six-song EP, 'Easter Lily,' only weeks after their prior surprise collection, 'Days of Ash.' This marks another unannounced music drop from the internationally renowned group, continuing their trend of direct fan engagement through immediate releases.
